title: EOS evidence ledger
description: registry/evidence.json, the canonical machine ledger: one record per source, never grouped. The Markdown view is derived. This schema formalises the existing eighteen-key record shape unchanged. Record id uniqueness is enforced by the checker, not expressible here.

research_cutoff.description: Latest access_date across the records, written by tools/import_fragments.py. Derived, not typed in.

version_or_commit.description: Exact tag, commit, version or dated revision inspected; the string unknown when none is discoverable.

licence.description: Load-bearing for reuse decisions: applied per source, never as a blanket class rule.

maintenance.description: . url-dead means the cited URL no longer resolves: the finding stands on the reading taken at access_date, but the citation cannot be re-checked at source, which is a different failure from content going stale.

finding.description: The principle extracted, not a summary of the abstract.

licence_evidence.description: What on the source establishes the licence, quoted. A licence with nothing behind it is a guess; ninety records once read 'unknown' because nobody had looked.

licence_checked.description: Date the licence was read off the source.
